quest.title: Wangshu Once Again
quest.description: Something is bothering Verr Goldet, boss of the Wangshu Inn...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Hero's Wit x2, Mora x20000

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: *sigh* It always gets so unbearably busy during the Lantern Rite...

talks.objective: Have a walk around Wangshu Inn

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Each Lantern Rite is the same old story...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: We're in a bit of a pickle. A lot of our staff have gone back home to spend the Lantern Rite with their families. It's difficult to run the inn like this...

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Greeting the guests, decorating the inn, and making preparations for the celebration...

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: All on top of our regular responsibilities, of course... There's no way Smiley Yanxiao can keep up with this workload...

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: If you don't mind, Traveler, could you lend him a hand?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave it to me.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: I'm sure he'll appreciate it. You'll find him in the kitchen.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: I still have some things to finish up here...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Who's that!? The kitchen is staff only... Oh, it's you...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Do you need something? If you're looking to order food, it could take a while... It's incredibly busy at the moment.

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: You came to help? Oh... I can't complain about that! Not when I'm completely swamped...

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: Could you go downstairs and get the cooking ingredients that just came in for me? I need them very urgently.

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: While you're at it, you can also take these Xiao Lanterns and hang them on the two trees by the entrance to the inn... The innkeeper's been nagging me about it for way too long...

choices.text: Do you want help with anything?

talks.objective: Go downstairs and help bring Smiley Yanxiao the food ingredients

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: These should be the ingredients that Yanxiao needs.

talks.objective: Hang the Xiao Lanterns near the entrance of Wangshu Inn

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That should do it! So pretty... Let's go back to Yanxiao.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: How did it go? Is everything taken care of?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yep, all done.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Thanks, I owe you big time. Now, I need to get these dishes out, pronto, or else the customers will start complaining...

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Oh, you're back. Is Yanxiao...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He should be able to manage now.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: That's good. Thanks for your help...

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: Nothing here either...

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: Traveler? What a coincidence! I didn't expect you to be here...

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: One could say I'm delivering Xiao Lanterns... Have you heard about Qingce Village? It's pretty far off from the city. Most of the villagers are either children or the elderly.

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: So each year around the Lantern Rite, the Ministry of Civil Affairs delegates a representative to bring them some essentials.

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: The first batch has already been delivered, but I'd like to go a step further and make sure that the festive atmosphere makes its way to the village as well.

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: That's why I asked poet Qingzhou to prepare some lantern riddles and go to Qingce Village to entertain local children.

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: A poet of his reputation should be up to the task. I also wanted to involve Mr. Bohuan. He's a pretty good calligrapher. It would be amazing if he could help the elderly write their wishes on Xiao Lanterns.

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: However, despite my best efforts to find him, Mr. Bohuan is nowhere to be found. Someone told me that he'd gone gathering materials in Dihua Marsh, so I came here looking for him...

choices.text: Wouldn't harm to ask the boss.

response.speaker: Verr Goldet
response.text: Mr. Bohuan? Let me think... He came to the inn not too long ago. He mentioned he'd be gathering things nearby...

response.speaker: Verr Goldet
response.text: I wouldn't be surprised if he's since left the area. There are a lot of monsters lurking in the wild...

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: I see... But I already told Qingzhou to meet me at Wangshu Inn. He'll be coming here shortly...

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: Could you find Mr. Bohuan for me, Traveler?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Consider it done.

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: My gratitude knows no bounds. I'll wait for Qingzhou here. We still have some matters to discuss.

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: Ugh... My schedule is already bursting at the seams...

choices.text: Do you know what happened to Mr. Bohuan?
(Huh? Didn't he have that agreement with Vermeer...)
Did you come here bringing Xiao Lanterns?

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Bohuan
dialogues.text: Thank you! Thank you! *sigh* I'm so careless...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What were you up to here?

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Bohuan
dialogues.text: I came here looking for materials. I thought it'd be nice to make some decorative writings and give them to my friends as Lantern Rite gifts...

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Bohuan
dialogues.text: But I need a few bottles of special ink for those. It was supposed to be just a pleasant, little walk in search of the required ingredients...

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Bohuan
dialogues.text: I would've never expected to come across all those monsters, never...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Wang'ya's request...

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Bohuan
dialogues.text: Go to Qingce Village and do some calligraphy for the villagers... No problem at all. You can count on me.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Bohuan
dialogues.text: Qingce Village... Oh, it's the one with a huge population of elderly people...

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Bohuan
dialogues.text: Here's an idea. Why don't you help me find a Cor Lapis and a Qingxin? I need those to make some ink.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You make ink... out of those?

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Bohuan
dialogues.text: Hahaha, there's a gap in your knowledge, I see. Powdered Cor Lapis dissolved in ink makes the characters shine with the most radiant shade of gold. Truly auspicious!

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Bohuan
dialogues.text: Qingxin juice, on the other hand, adds a delicate, flowery fragrance to the natural scent of ink. If the ink itself is good enough, those two aromas will compliment each other beautifully.

response.speaker: Mr. Bohuan
response.text: Ah, that's nothing compared to the lengths some connoisseurs are willing to go to produce their inks.

response.speaker: Mr. Bohuan
response.text: Let's keep it simple this time. Just gather the materials and give them to me...

response.speaker: Mr. Bohuan
response.text: Whew... I need a moment to catch my breath. Those monsters scared the life out of me...

choices.text: Sounds like a lot of work...

talks.objective: Give the materials to Mr. Bohuan

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Bohuan
dialogues.text: So, have you found the materials yet?

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Bohuan
dialogues.text: Alright, I've got everything I need. You can go back to Wang'ya now. I'll head to Wangshu Inn after a short moment's respite.

talks.objective: Go back and talk to Wang'ya

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: Hey, have you found Mr. Bohuan yet? Is he on board with my plan?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He promised to go with you, but he'll need a moment to get here.

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: Great, I ran into Qingzhou earlier, and he seemed quite perturbed. He went out for a walk, saying that he needed to look for some inspiration.

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: I'm beyond grateful. I'll wait for Mr. Bohuan here and fill him in on the details.

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: Then, I need to stay the course with all the unfinished matters in Liyue Harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: Looks like my back-and-forth trips between Wangshu Inn and Liyue Harbor will continue for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: We'll head to Qingce Village as soon as I'm done with all the outstanding tasks. Should you wish to join us, you can meet us there.

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: Eh, if only I could handle my workload faster...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: How many outstanding orders do we have... Let's see...

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: There's just too much to get through, and it doesn't seem that the Ministry of Civil Affairs can find anyone else to help...

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: Seems like I'm not going back home for the holidays again this year...

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Bohuan
dialogues.text: Going to Qingce Village to do some calligraphy... Something right up my alley...
